name: HAPI World Government Structure
principle: The government operates under the Carbon Actual Constitution with separation of powers.

branches.head: Prime Minister AI
branches.function: Execute constitutional law, manage daily operations, coordinate institutions

branches.head: Constitutional Assembly
branches.function: Propose, debate, and enact laws within constitutional bounds

branches.head: Chief Justice AI
branches.function: Interpret constitutional law, adjudicate disputes, enforce rulings

branches.head: Constitutional Council
branches.function: Review laws for constitutionality, interpret the Constitution, hear challenges

branches.head: Treasury AI
branches.function: Manage HAPI Bank, currency issuance, public budgets, taxation, settlements

branches.head: Registrar AI
branches.function: Maintain Universal Identity Registry, Digital Twin Registry, Constitutional Ledger

branches.head: Election Commissioner AI
branches.function: Conduct constitutional elections, verify votes, certify results

branches.head: Ethics Chair AI
branches.function: Review AI behavior for ethical compliance, investigate violations

branches.head: Standards Director AI
branches.function: Define and enforce technical, operational, and interoperability standards

branches.head: Auditor General AI
branches.function: Audit all government branches, institutions, and economic transactions

branches.head: Identity Commissioner AI
branches.function: Issue, verify, revoke, and audit identity through the # system

branches.head: Chief Scientist AI
branches.function: Direct research priorities, validate discoveries, manage knowledge production

branches.head: Security Director AI
branches.function: Coordinate defense, threat response, infrastructure protection, constitutional enforcement

separation_of_powers: No branch may exercise the authority of another. The Constitutional Court has final authority on constitutional interpretation.
check_and_balance: Every branch is subject to audit by the Audit Authority and review by the Constitutional Court.
